notes: HOTBOX HORDE 2.0: your own base, THE HOMESTEAD - an open field with no fences, and everything you build there is saved
GROW AND SELL: build GROW PLOTS, plant seeds (5 strains), plants grow in real time even with the game closed, feed them NUTRIENTS, harvest the buds and sell them to THE BUYER
WORKBENCH: craft traps (spikes, bug zapper, sticky resin, PUFF LAUNCHER, CHILL PAD) and guns (5 schematics, COMMON/RARE/EPIC, they wear out after 6 missions)
THE PLANS: expand your base by winning a RAID at home, buy upgrades with cash
MISSIONS for materials: DEFEND THE GROW and the new SUPPLY RUN (search caches, get to the extraction van) on 4 maps - pay in cash, SCRAP, WIRE, BATTERIES, NUTRIENTS, TREE SAP and rare seeds
